correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT n1.category FROM links AS l INNER JOIN edges AS e ON l.link_id = e.link_id INNER JOIN nodes AS n1 ON e.src_id = n1.node_id WHERE l.link_kind = 'active'

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant joins a second alias of the referenced entity table and projects both aliases' non-key attributes under SELECT DISTINCT, preventing deduplication when two edges share the same source category but differ on destination category.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT DISTINCT n1.category, n2.category FROM links AS l INNER JOIN edges AS e ON l.link_id = e.link_id INNER JOIN nodes AS n1 ON e.src_id = n1.node_id INNER JOIN nodes AS n2 ON e.dst_id = n2.node_id WHERE l.link_kind = 'active'
